items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: And then my mother brought me one.

ctx.x: Yeah, so you have to cover the holes of your fingers. Yeah.

Well, this is me, just like a one part of it. Less keys. There was twelve keys. He didn't have many keys. There was an ordinary albis, a clarinet of the air. I didn't know it cost me four dollars. I paid four dollars for the clarinet. And I got a keys. It was a ship like a coffin. It was leather. You take your clarinet of the part, two compartments. You put one half in. One half there. One half there. One of the ship. And it would come up. And I used that till the next card that my daddy bought for me. The oil…
About when did you buy that thing, you remember?
